## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `make test` passes
- [ ] `make lint` and `make validate` pass
- [ ] No dataset rows, PCAPs, model binaries or secrets in the diff
- [ ] Schema changed? `schema_version` bumped and `make schema-docs` run
- [ ] Preprocessing rules changed? `preprocessing.version` bumped
- [ ] New numbers in docs come from a committed results file or command output (with input SHA-256)
- [ ] New `[VERIFY]` items added to `docs/VERIFY.md`
- [ ] ADR added for any significant decision
